name: rust-nested-discovery-evidence
body: Verified this session: src/rustlib is a separate Cargo project (apg-rustfrontend, own Cargo.lock + isolated src/rustlib/target/, edition = "2021", ra_ap_* deps pinned to a rust-analyzer git tag); the Rust frontend loads only one manifest via ProjectManifest::discover_single (src/rustlib/src/main.rs:513), so scanning from the repo root loads only the root apg package and src/rustlib produces no module and no symbols (confirmed in the branch DB: no rustlib / apg-rustfrontend module). The frontend can load a nested dir when pointed at it — the gap is discovery/orchestration only. Explicitly not the fix: joining the root workspace (isolation is deliberate, build.rs:183-208). Source: code graph + source read. verified.
